      public AuthToken(String username, AuthToken.Role role, String secretKey)
      Constructs a newly issued AuthToken and computes its SHA-256 HMAC signature.
      Parameters:
      username - client identity name
      role - assigned RBAC role
      secretKey - cryptographic signing secret

    • AuthToken

      public AuthToken(String tokenId, String username, AuthToken.Role role, long issueTimestamp, String signature)
      Reconstructs an existing AuthToken from validated wire transport fields.
      Parameters:
      tokenId - unique token identifier
      username - client identity name
      role - assigned RBAC role
      issueTimestamp - token epoch issue timestamp in milliseconds
      signature - cryptographic signature string
